item.title: WBR Fire: Wood chips burning in fire at Port of Greater Baton Rouge
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; A fire broke out at the Port of Greater Baton Rouge Saturday morning after wood chips caught fire on a conveyor system used to load materials onto ships along the Mississippi River.Firefighters with West Baton Rouge Fire and EMS responded just before noon with assistance from the Baton Rouge Fire Department.The Port of Greater Baton Rouge is one of the busiest ports in the United States, serving as a major shipping hub where vessels from more than 30 countries move goods thro

item.title: One in critical condition following shooting on Old Hermitage Parkway off Gardere Lane
item.description: GARDERE &mdash; Deputies with the East Baton Rouge Parish Sheriff's Office responded to a shooting that left one person injured on Saturday.The shooting occurred around 12 p.m. behind an apartment complex on Old Hermitage Parkway off Gardere Lane.&nbsp;One person was injured as a result of the shooting. They were transported to a local hospital in critical condition.&nbsp;Further details are not currently available.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Baton Rouge Metropolitan Airport conducts tri-annual disaster simulation

item.title: St. Francisville hosts Walk in the Park event
item.description: ST. FRANCISVILLE &mdash; Residents in West Feliciana Parish enjoyed a day filled with music and entertainment as the community hosted its Walk in the Park event on Saturday.Members of the community gathered at Parker Park to enjoy live music, art and local crafts as more than a dozen vendors lined the sidewalk.&nbsp;Vendors sold various items, including handmade jewelry and homemade birdhouses, among other gifts.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Parade organizers host fundraiser for Clinton Mardi Gras shooting victims

item.title: Trailer fire reignites after being extinguished on Deck Boulevard in Ascension Parish
item.description: GEISMAR &mdash; The Gesimar Volunteer Fire Department responded to a trailer fire on Deck Boulevard Friday evening after the trailer reignited following an earlier blaze.According to the department, crews responded to the original trailer fire around 2:30 p.m. After the flames were extinguished, the fire reignited around 7 p.m. as portions of the trailer that survived the original blaze caught on fire.Fire officials believe both fires were caused by an electrical malfunction in the laundry room

item.title: 'LA Psych Fest' music festival held in downtown Baton Rouge
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A big celebration of local music took place in downtown Baton Rouge at the "LA Psych Fest."Dozens of local artists performed across three stages under the overpass in what organizers say is an "immersive celebration of the raw edge of music."There were also many vendors selling art, clothes and food.Permalink| Comments

item.title: LSU baseball game against Sacramento State on Sunday postponed due to weather
item.description: BATON ROUGE - LSU baseball's game against Sacramento State on Sunday was moved due to inclement weather.The game will now be played at 6 p.m., LSU said. LSU played and lost to Sacramento State on Saturday.Permalink| Comments
